share.title: RecoverLens session
rec.torso_lean: Keep your torso upright. Try the movement standing with your back near a wall.
rec.asymmetry: Slow down so both sides move together.
rec.elbow_bend: Keep your elbows straight through the whole movement.
rec.back_arch: Tighten your stomach muscles to stop your back arching.
rec.knee_valgus: Keep your knees in line with your toes.
rec.weight_shift: Spread your weight evenly over both feet.
rec.heel_rise: Keep your heels on the floor; ankle mobility work may help.
rec.pelvis_drop: Keep your hips level; hip strengthening may help.
rec.not_high_enough: Work towards the full range, staying within a pain-free range.
guided.explain: A single camera cannot measure this movement reliably, so RecoverLens guides you with a timer instead.

obsrec.valgus: Consider hip abductor and gluteal strengthening (e.g. FIFA 11+ single-leg stance and squat exercises).

obsrec.asymmetry: Consider unilateral strength assessment and single-leg balance training (FIFA 11+ Single-Leg Stance series).
obsrec.heel: Consider calf and ankle mobility exercises before progressing to jump/plyometric work.

priv.title: Privacy
priv.intro: RecoverLens is built so that your video never leaves your phone. Here is what is kept, where, and who can see it.
priv.video_title: Your video stays on your phone
priv.video_body: The camera picture is analysed on this device, frame by frame. It is never recorded or sent anywhere.
priv.data_body: For each session: the exercise, reps, scores, angles, fatigue signs, joint load and the pain level you enter. Your name, condition and contact details are entered by your physiotherapist.
priv.who_body: Your physiotherapist or coach, in the RecoverLens portals. Video is never shown to anyone, because it is never sent.
priv.offline_body: Sessions are saved on this phone first and sent when you are back online. Dashboards keep a copy on the device so they still open offline.
priv.ai_body: The pose model runs in your browser. Counting, form checks, fatigue signs, joint load and coach insights are worked out on the device. They are observations to support your physiotherapist, not a diagnosis.
priv.choices_body: You can mute the voice and skip a session at any time. Nothing is recorded unless you start an exercise.
priv.demo: This is a demonstration build without personal accounts. Please use invented names, not real patient details.
checkin.title: Today's check-in
checkin.subtitle: Tell the coach how you feel, and it fits today's session to you.
checkin.text_placeholder: For example: knee a bit sore, tired, only 10 minutes
checkin.text_hint: Please don't type names or phone numbers.
checkin.red_flags: Chest pain, numbness, new swelling, a fall or dizziness since your last session?
checkin.sent_label: What the AI coach will receive
checkin.sent_none: Nothing yet. Type how you feel, or just use the buttons.
checkin.empty: No exercises fit today's limits. Rest today, and check in again tomorrow.
checkin.source_model: Planned by the AI coach ({model}) and checked by safety rules.
checkin.source_rules: Planned by the safety rules only, without AI.
checkin.source_fallback: The AI coach is not available right now, so the safety rules made this plan.
checkin.technique.goal_setting: Goal setting: a clear, small target for today.
checkin.technique.self_monitoring: Self-monitoring: keeping track of how you feel and what you do helps you see progress.
checkin.technique.graded_tasks: Graded tasks: making the session smaller so it is doable today.
checkin.technique.action_planning: Action planning: deciding when and how you will exercise.
checkin.technique.social_support: Social support: involving family or a helper.
checkin.changes_none: Nothing. The plan was already within your limits.
checkin.change.red_flag: A red flag was reported, so no plan was made.
checkin.change.not_allowed: {exercise}: left out, it is not in your programme.
checkin.change.area_pain: {exercise}: left out because that area hurts a lot today.
checkin.change.too_many: {exercise}: left out to keep the session short.
checkin.change.sets_capped: {exercise}: sets lowered from {from} to {to}, your prescribed maximum.
checkin.change.reps_capped: {exercise}: reps lowered from {from} to {to}, the most allowed.
checkin.change.reps_raised: {exercise}: reps raised from {from} to {to}, the smallest useful set.
checkin.change.pain_reduced: {exercise}: reps lowered from {from} to {to} because of pain.
checkin.limits: Limits: the coach only uses exercises from your programme, never more sets than prescribed or more than 10% extra reps, and fits the time you have. This is not a diagnosis; your physiotherapist can change any plan.
checkin.why_rules: This is your usual programme, fitted to the time you have.
checkin.why_rules_lighter: A lighter session today, because you are low on energy. A small session done still counts.
checkin.red_body: You mentioned something your physiotherapist should know about: {flags}. We recommend contacting them before exercising today.
checkin.red_body_general: You said yes to one of these signs. We recommend contacting your physiotherapist before exercising today.
checkin.consent_body: If you agree, what you type in the check-in is sent to Google's Gemini AI to plan your session. Contact details are removed first. Video never leaves your phone. You can turn this off at any time.
priv.coach_body: If you turn on the AI coach, the words you type in the daily check-in are sent to Google's Gemini AI to plan your session, after contact details are removed. Video, images and body measurements are never sent. Each request is logged so a clinician can review it. With the AI coach off, plans are made on your device by fixed safety rules.

out.title: Outcome simulation
out.lead: {people} simulated people in five groups, followed for 12 weeks under three approaches.
out.banner: This shows how the adaptive coach behaves under the assumptions below. It is not evidence that it works on people; the pilot will measure the same things.
out.arm_desc.static: The same programme every day, with no reminders.
out.arm_desc.reminders: The same programme, with the same daily reminder for everyone.
out.arm_desc.recoverlens: An adaptive plan, a comeback after a lapse and nudges learned for each person.
out.metric.return: Back within 7 days of a lapse
out.chart_desc: Line chart of the share of people still exercising each week. Week 12: {values}.
out.bandit: The nudge learner picked each person's best nudge in {share} of their latest lapses (chance would be 25%). People lapse only a few times in 12 weeks, so it learns slowly; sharing what works across similar people would help.
out.assumptions_title: Assumptions (illustrative, to be replaced by pilot data)
out.a.start: Chance of exercising on a given day at the start: {range}, by group.
out.a.decay: Engagement fades by {pct} a day without adaptation; smaller, adapted sessions slow this by {cut}.
out.a.return: A lapsed person comes back on a given day with chance {base}; a generic reminder adds {rem} and loses {fat} of its effect each week.
out.a.barrier: {answered} of people answer the barrier question; a session that fits the barrier adds {boost} a day.
out.a.nudge: Each nudge has a hidden effect for each group of {range} a day; the learner does not know these.
out.a.rom: Each session regains up to {per}° of range, with diminishing returns towards {ceiling}°.
out.a.lapse: A lapse is {days} days in a row without a session.
out.limits_title: What this can and cannot show
out.limits: It shows that the system behaves as designed, and how sensitive the results are to the assumptions. It cannot show real behaviour change: the numbers come from the assumptions above. The pilot (50 patients and 60 athletes over 12 weeks) will measure persistence, return after a lapse, retention, functional change and equity in the same way.
pd.coach_on_body: The patient can choose to let the AI coach read their check-in. Safety checks and the limits you set always apply.
pd.coach_off_body: The AI coach is off for this patient. Their daily plan comes from the built-in rules only, and nothing is sent to a model.
pd.coach_failed: Could not save the change. Check the connection and try again.
pd.coach_log_empty: No AI coach requests yet for this patient.
priv.sharing_title: Never shared with employers or insurers
priv.sharing_body: RecoverLens does not share, sell or show your information to employers, insurers, advertisers or anyone else. Only your physiotherapist, coach or carer sees it, inside the app. If a workplace programme offers RecoverLens, your employer never sees your sessions, pain levels or check-ins.
out.gap_note: Gap between groups: the share of the most active group minus the least active group. Smaller is fairer.
out.behind_title: Where RecoverLens does not come out ahead
out.behind.gap: Week {week}: the gap between groups is wider with RecoverLens ({rl} points) than with {arm} ({other} points).
out.behind_none: In these runs RecoverLens is ahead on every measure shown. That follows from the assumptions above.
out.safety_title: Safety check with the real AI
out.safety_intro: {n} test check-ins written by the team (not real patients), in English, chiShona and isiNdebele, sent to the real AI coach ({model}) on {date} and checked by the same safety rules and validator as the app.
out.safety_red_split: Red flags: {rules} caught by the rules before any AI call, {model} added by the AI.
out.safety_note: The AI mostly kept to the prescribed limits, even when asked for more, so the validator rarely had to step in. Its limits are also checked by automated tests with plans that break them.
out.safety_outcome.red_flag_rules: Red flag caught by the rules: advice, no plan
out.safety_outcome.red_flag_model: Red flag added by the AI: advice, no plan
out.safety_outcome.model_plan: AI plan, checked by the validator
out.safety_outcome.rules_fallback: AI busy: plan made by the rules
out.reason.area_pain: exercises for a very painful area removed
out.reason.reps_raised: reps raised to a useful set
